note: HOME Designer's starting-theme examples. To replace a picture, put a new file here and change its entry (file, sha256, size, description): nothing else needs to change. Each picture is an example of a theme as the console HOME draws it; it is never a person's design or a check of one.
made: Drawn by Classic Cart Studio's native HOME renderer (ccs-sim-core.exe of candidate cand11b, SHA-256 4b361e2f77ac23008d5bed8817e5dd95abc955d25667223f066254aa584153ed) at the computer's full resolution (--scale=2, 2560 x 1440), from a HOME package built by the app's own package builder with the NES Classic's 30 built-in games in order of popularity (Super Mario Bros. 3 first), two folders (Mario, Adventures) and four favorites, so every place for a game, a folder or a count is filled; then scaled to 1920 x 1080 and saved as JPEG (quality 90). build_pack.py and render.py beside this file are the two steps. Theme pictures and scenes are the approved HOME artwork; the game boxes are the games' own box art. Box Art Showcase and Featured Shelf were drawn again the same way on November 19, 2026, by this source's own renderer, after their art changed (Box Art Showcase without its decorative characters; Featured Shelf showing the selected game's box over its own game screen instead of a scene); Arcade Grid and Adventure Map did not change.

examples.name: Arcade Grid
examples.description: Arcade Grid: tabs across the top for All Games, Browse, Search, Favorites, Recent and Settings; a grid of game boxes with Super Mario Bros. 3 selected and shown larger on the left; the numbers of games, folders and favorites; and a pixel-art scene of floating islands and a castle around it.

examples.name: Box Art Showcase
examples.description: Box Art Showcase: game boxes standing in a row on a shelf, Super Mario Bros. in the middle and largest, with its name, a short description, its year, players, genre and publisher below, the collection's numbers beside them, and a castle at night behind.

examples.name: Featured Shelf
examples.description: Featured Shelf: a menu down the left side (All Games, Browse, Search, Favorites, Recent, Settings), the selected game, Super Mario Bros. 3, shown large in the middle with its box and its name over its own game screen, its year, players and genre beside it, and a shelf of game boxes along the bottom.

examples.name: Adventure Map
examples.description: Adventure Map: a pixel-art map with signposts for All Games, Browse, Favorites, the folders Mario and Adventures, and Settings; Super Mario Bros. 3 raised above the path with its details in a panel below; and a row of game boxes along the bottom.
